how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for ICAR IARI Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 28-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICAR IARI Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 28-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR IARI Senior Research Fellow positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 28th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Tech/Bachelor degree in Computer Sciences, followed by a Master's degree in Computer Science/IT/Information Security/Information Sciences/MCA or equivalent. Those with a 3-year Bachelor's degree must have NET qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow position is 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST, women, and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000 plus HRA per month, as admissible.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Senior Research Fellow positions in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is through email. Candidates need to send their applications to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for ICAR IARI Senior Research Fellow positions?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for any category of candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Senior Research Fellow positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial screening of applications followed by an in-person interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The Senior Research Fellow positions are on a contractual basis for specific projects.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Indian Agricultural Research Institute (ICAR IARI) located?
faq.answer: The Indian Agricultural Research Institute (ICAR IARI) is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110012.
